text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today is the academy-sponsored BBQ event! 
Stay Gold, who joined along, has been in 
high spirits since morning.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Ooooh--! Nothing beats meat, after all!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Yakiniku restaurants are great, but a BBQ 
under the blue sky is awesome too! Hahaha!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"Heeeeeey! Mr. Steeee-goooo! Are you 
eating your meeeeat?!"

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
"I'm eating, I'm eating. Man, everything's 
so delicious."

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I baked this with all my heart! Please 
have some!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Oh, thanks. I'm glad I get to eat it 
cooked authentic-style.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Mmm~gh! Stay! Stay, Gold! I brought you 
some miso soup packed with vegetables, 
too!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I absolutely want you to taste this berry 
delicious treat, too... Now, go on and 
eaaat!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Um, SteGo-san. We brought some cake too, 
so if you'd like...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
It was extremely popular, and this was the 
very last one~! I rushed to secure it 
right away~. Please, accept this as a 
small token of my daily gratitude...♪

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
You guys too? Thanks. Hahaha, this is an 
incredible amount.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking at the food laid out across the 
table, I'm reminded once again of her 
sheer popularity. Still, this quantity is 
surely a bit much...

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Is it a bit too tight? I really appreciate 
the thought, though.
choice_data_list: Let's take them little by little.
Let's eat as much as we can!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
You're right. It'll probably keep 
increasing after this, too...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Stego was here?! Hey, did you eat this? 
Stego-saaan, have some seconds! Ah, I 
brought some too~!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Alright, alright. Everyone, just leave 
them there~

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
We'll just snack on it bit by bit. 
Trainer, you have some too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, as everyone came and went, I got 
to try a little bit of all their 
recommendations!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha...! Right on, we're doing a 
barbecue after all. Let's push it to the 
absolute limit!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Despite her words, people quickly began 
gathering around her one after another...

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
—Oh, it's you! Long time no see. How've 
you been?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Stay Gold chatted, played around... She 
kept popping back to the table, taking a 
bite then stopping, taking another bite 
then stopping...

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Pheeew, I ate so much...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Taking a whole day, she finished eating it 
all at her own pace!
